address_note: gov.uk's find-driving-test-centre results could not be read from this machine (the form page loads, the results page returns nothing to a script). The address is taken from passrates.uk, which quotes DVSA's find a driving test centre data captured 2026-05-12 (56 Glebe Way, West Wickham BR4 0RL), and matched by drivingtesttips.biz's centre page and Drive Johnsons' centre list. OSM has Glebe Way (A232) way/166970749 and Rose Walk way/14756873 within about 100 m of the given position, which sits on the corner of the two. Every old route list leaves by Rose Walk, so the centre has not moved since they were written. Recheck on gov.uk when reachable.

summary: 10 confirmed and 19 likely places (23 roads, 6 junctions): the old route lists (s1, s2 counted once) name many roads round the centre, and a separate instructor's lessons page confirms the Glebe Way roundabout, the Kent Gate Way roundabouts, Corkscrew Hill, the High Street and the A232 junctions by Wickham Court Road. Two routes meeting the overlap rule look possible from the map (east by Glebe Way and the Glebe Way roundabout, back by Addington Road and Corkscrew Hill; north by Station Road and Red Lodge Road).
